description: A bootstrap of another notation (engine §9). Each rule of the syntax document of the notation, except text, has a new name in turn. A renamed rule is a wrapper, and the reader reads through it. A rename in loads gives a pipeline, which parses each of the inputs as loads says. Any other rename is a grammar error of loading. control is what the bundled bootstrap gives. It is also what the bundled bootstrap gives when a wrapper of its own stands around each of these rules.
document:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%features f g
%const $K (A ∪ B)
%redefine-const $K (A ∪ B ∪ ∅)
%classifier lex f? "mi" ∈ KOHA ¬g? "do" ∉ KOHA


%implies (A ∩ B) ⟹ (C ∖ D)
%rule text :: (V ∪ (($x ∧ $x.source-text.classify(lex) ⊆ W) ⟹ X)) :- $.verbatim-text | f? ($x:word $y:"l"="l" [("c" | "d")] [+KU "z"] {"e"} ("f" & "g") "h".."k" _Lu Sound-0061-s H "m"<¬B>) :: (T ∪ $K) | ¬f? ($z:"b" [("c" [$w:"n"])]) :: U | ("q" text-tail) %conditions (($x.source-text = "ok" ∨ $y.starts-input) ⟹ (¬$x.first-token.parse(word) ∧ $y)), $x.tokens-after-first.parse(word …), $y.source-text ∈ "a.b".split(".") %warning "message text" %suppress-warnings text %emits $x ($y) :: ($x.tags ∩ $x.source-text.classify(lex)), ε :: Y







%rule word {"w"}

%rule text-tail ε

%redefine-rule text-tail (🆓 "r")

%extend-rule text-tail "s"

%rule 🆓 "t"

%rule unused-splice *unused-helper
%rule unused-helper "u"
%rule unused-error "u" %error "invalid u"
%rule captured "j" [$j:+T] %conditions ¬$j
%rule unused-parse $p:"p"
%conditions $p.parse("p" …).error-free
```
